# Command-line options

These tables come from the option definitions in the code. `--help` shows the same. Every command also takes
`--help` and `--version`. A misspelled option or a wrong value stops the command with a short message, for
example `ecosim-server: error: argument --steps: must be a whole number of at least 1, not '0'`. For a misspelled
option the message suggests the closest one. The [exit codes](#exit-codes) are at the end of the page.

After changing an option, run `uv run --project examples python dev/generate_cli_reference.py` in the
repository root.

## ecosim new

`ecosim new`: Writes a simulation folder from FMUs. Connects each input to the output of another model with the same name. Checks the result like ecosim check.

```shell
ecosim new my_simulation house.fmu occupancy.fmu weather.fmu --duration 1y --start-date 2023-01-01
ecosim new my_simulation models --step-size 1min --steps 200
ecosim new two_houses weather.fmu house=house.fmu house2=house.fmu
ecosim new plant_simulation plant.fmu controller.fmu --connect controller.T=plant.T_out --logical-delay controller.T=293.15
```

**Positional arguments**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SIMULATION` | yes |  | The new simulation folder. Must be empty or not exist yet. |
| `FMU` | yes |  | An FMU file, a folder with .fmu files, or NAME=FILE to name the model. |

**Options**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--debug` |  | flag | Show debug messages and the full traceback of an error. |

**Run**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--step-size DURATION` |  |  | The simulated time of one step, like 15min or 1s, or a number in milliseconds. Default: 15min. |
| `--duration DURATION` |  |  | The simulated time of the simulation, like 12h, 30d or 1y (365 days). Default: 1d. |
| `--steps N` |  |  | The number of steps, instead of --duration. |
| `--start-date DATE` |  |  | The start of the simulated time, like 2023-01-01 or 2023-01-01T06:00+01:00. Default: 2024-01-01. |

**Connections**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--connect INPUT=OUTPUT` |  |  | Connects an input to an output of another name, like house.T_out=weather.T_dry. Can be given several times. |
| `--logical-delay INPUT[=START]` |  |  | Gives a connected input the value of the previous step to break a loop. START is its value in the first step. Can be given several times. |

**Results**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--database-type {postgres,file}` |  | `file` | Where the results go, written to type in the [database] section of the server config. |
| `--database-directory FOLDER` |  | `results/manual` | The folder for the result files of a server started manually. ecosim run writes each run to its own folder in results. |

**Server connection**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--port PORT` |  | `1234` | The port of the server, written to the server config and to every client config. ecosim run picks a free one instead. |

## ecosim check

`ecosim check`: Checks a simulation before a run. Lists every problem with its file. Options after -- are checked as options of ecosim-server.

```shell
ecosim check building
ecosim check building --duration 365d
ecosim check building_hpc --database-type postgres --steps 100 -- --database-schema run_2
```

**Positional arguments**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SIMULATION` |  |  | The simulation folder with server/ and modules/. Default: the current folder. |

**Options**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--debug` |  | flag | Show debug messages and the full traceback of an error. |

**Config files**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--simulation-config FILE` |  |  | The simulation config, instead of SIMULATION/server/simulation.json. |
| `--server-config FILE` |  |  | The server config, instead of SIMULATION/server/preferences.ini. |
| `--simulator-dir FOLDER` |  |  | The folder with one folder for each simulator, instead of SIMULATION/modules. |

**Run**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--steps N` |  |  | How many steps the simulation runs. Overrides setup.steps in the simulation config. With --restore-simulation-run it is the number of steps of the whole run. |
| `--duration DURATION` |  |  | The simulated time of the run, like 90min, 12h or 365d. Must be a whole number of steps. |
| `--step-size DURATION` |  |  | The simulated time of one step, like 15min or 1s, or a number in milliseconds. Overrides setup.delta_t in the simulation config. |
| `--pace NUMBER` |  | `1` | Slows the run down. At 0 the server waits 4 seconds before it sends a simulator its step, at 1 it does not wait. |
| `--restore-simulation-run` |  | flag | Continues an aborted run from its stored results, or starts a new run if there is none. Needs the unchanged config files. |

**Results**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--database-type {postgres,file}` |  |  | Where the results go. Overrides type in the [database] section of the server config. Default: file. |

## ecosim run

`ecosim run`: Runs a simulation locally. Starts the server and one client per simulator. Logs are in the run folder. Options after -- are passed to ecosim-server.

```shell
ecosim run building --steps 100
ecosim run building --duration 365d --step-size 1h
ecosim run building --steps 100 --database-type postgres -- --database-schema run_2
```

**Positional arguments**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SIMULATION` |  |  | The simulation folder with server/ and modules/. Default: the current folder. |

**Options**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--debug` |  | flag | Show debug messages and the full traceback of an error. |
| `--no-check` |  | flag | Starts without checking the simulation first. |

**Config files**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--simulation-config FILE` |  |  | The simulation config, instead of SIMULATION/server/simulation.json. |
| `--server-config FILE` |  |  | The server config, instead of SIMULATION/server/preferences.ini. |
| `--simulator-dir FOLDER` |  |  | The folder with one folder for each simulator, instead of SIMULATION/modules. |

**Run**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--steps N` |  |  | How many steps the simulation runs. Overrides setup.steps in the simulation config. With --restore-simulation-run it is the number of steps of the whole run. |
| `--duration DURATION` |  |  | The simulated time of the run, like 90min, 12h or 365d. Must be a whole number of steps. |
| `--step-size DURATION` |  |  | The simulated time of one step, like 15min or 1s, or a number in milliseconds. Overrides setup.delta_t in the simulation config. |
| `--pace NUMBER` |  | `1` | Slows the run down. At 0 the server waits 4 seconds before it sends a simulator its step, at 1 it does not wait. |
| `--restore-simulation-run` |  | flag | Continues an aborted run from its stored results, or starts a new run if there is none. Needs the unchanged config files. |

**Results**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--database-type {postgres,file}` |  |  | Where the results go. Overrides type in the [database] section of the server config. Default: file. |
| `--results FOLDER` |  |  | The run folder for the results and the logs. Default: a new folder in SIMULATION/results. |

**Server connection**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--port PORT` |  |  | The port the server listens on. Default: a free port. |

## ecosim results

`ecosim results`: Shows the results of a run with the minimum, mean and maximum of every output. With --csv it writes them as one table to a CSV file.

```shell
ecosim results building
ecosim results building --csv results.csv
ecosim results building --interface house.T_indoor --interface weather --csv temperatures.csv
ecosim results --server-config building/server/preferences.ini --database-schema run_2
```

**Positional arguments**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FOLDER` |  |  | A simulation folder for its newest run, a run folder, or a folder of result files. Default: the current folder. |

**Options**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--debug` |  | flag | Show debug messages and the full traceback of an error. |
| `--simulation-config FILE` |  |  | The simulation config of the run. Only needed for results in PostgreSQL, or for a folder without a copy of it. |

**Table**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--inputs` |  | flag | Show the inputs too. |
| `--interface NAME` |  |  | Show only this column, or all columns of a simulator or an array. Can be given several times. |
| `--csv FILE` |  |  | Write the shown columns to this CSV file. |

**Results in PostgreSQL**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--server-config FILE` |  |  | The server config of the run, instead of FOLDER. Its [database] section says where the results are. |
| `--database-type {postgres,file}` |  |  | Where the results go. Overrides type in the [database] section of the config file. If neither sets it, postgres. |
| `--database-host HOST` |  |  | The host of the PostgreSQL server. Overrides server in the [database] section of the config file. |
| `--database-port PORT` |  |  | The port of the PostgreSQL server. Overrides port in the [database] section of the config file. |
| `--database-user USER` |  |  | The PostgreSQL user. Overrides username in the [database] section of the config file. |
| `--database-user-password PASSWORD` |  |  | The password of the PostgreSQL user. Other users on a shared machine can see it in the process list. Without it, the password comes from the config file, PGPASSWORD or a password file. |
| `--database-name NAME` |  |  | The PostgreSQL database. Default: sim_control. |
| `--database-schema NAME` |  |  | The PostgreSQL schema of the result tables. Default: sim_control. |
| `--database-ssl {true,false}` |  |  | true connects to PostgreSQL with sslmode=require, false with sslmode=disable. Overrides ssl in the [database] section of the config file. |

## Server

`ecosim-server`: Runs a simulation. Waits until one client per simulator is connected. Stores the results in files or in PostgreSQL.

```shell
ecosim-server --server-config server/preferences.ini --simulation-config server/simulation.json \
    --steps 100 --database-type file --database-directory results
ecosim-server --server-config server/preferences.ini --simulation-config server/simulation.json \
    --steps 35040 --step-size 900000 --restore-simulation-run
```

**Options**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--debug` |  | flag | Show debug messages and the full traceback of an error. |

**Config files**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--server-config FILE` | yes |  | The server's config file, usually server/preferences.ini. A relative path starts in the current folder. |
| `--simulation-config FILE` | yes |  | The simulators and their connections, usually server/simulation.json. A relative path starts in the current folder. |

**Run**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--steps N` |  |  | How many steps the simulation runs. Overrides setup.steps in the simulation config. With --restore-simulation-run it is the number of steps of the whole run. |
| `--step-size MILLISECONDS` |  |  | The simulated time of one step. Overrides setup.delta_t in the simulation config. |
| `--pace NUMBER` |  | `1` | Slows the run down. At 0 the server waits 4 seconds before it sends a simulator its step, at 1 it does not wait. |
| `--restore-simulation-run` |  | flag | Continues an aborted run from its stored results, or starts a new run if there is none. Needs the unchanged config files. |

**Results**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--database-type {postgres,file}` |  |  | Where the results go. Overrides type in the [database] section of the config file. If neither sets it, postgres. |
| `--database-directory FOLDER` |  |  | The folder for the result files of --database-type file. Overrides directory in the [database] section of the config file. If neither sets it, simulation_results. |
| `--database-host HOST` |  |  | The host of the PostgreSQL server. Overrides server in the [database] section of the config file. |
| `--database-port PORT` |  |  | The port of the PostgreSQL server. Overrides port in the [database] section of the config file. |
| `--database-user USER` |  |  | The PostgreSQL user. Overrides username in the [database] section of the config file. |
| `--database-user-password PASSWORD` |  |  | The password of the PostgreSQL user. Other users on a shared machine can see it in the process list. Without it, the password comes from the config file, PGPASSWORD or a password file. |
| `--database-name NAME` |  |  | The PostgreSQL database. Default: sim_control. |
| `--database-schema NAME` |  |  | The PostgreSQL schema of the result tables. Default: sim_control. |
| `--database-ssl {true,false}` |  |  | true connects to PostgreSQL with sslmode=require, false with sslmode=disable. Overrides ssl in the [database] section of the config file. |
| `--database-drop-existing-schema` |  | flag | Deletes the PostgreSQL schema of an earlier run with all its results. With --restore-simulation-run the schema is kept. |

**Server connection**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--host HOST` |  |  | The host name or IP address the server listens on. Overrides host in the [server] section of the config file. |
| `--port PORT` |  |  | The port the server listens on. Overrides port in the [server] section of the config file. |
| `--communication-protocol {dask,tcp_socket}` |  |  | The protocol between the server and the clients, by default tcp_socket. Overrides communication_protocol in the [server] section of the config file. |

**Image rendering**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--image-renderer-port PORT` |  |  | The port of the image rendering socket. Without it, the server opens no such socket. |
| `--image-renderer-interval N` |  |  | Renders images every N steps and sends them over the image rendering socket. Without it, no images are sent. |

## FMU clients

`ecosim-client-fmu-v2`: Runs an FMI 2.0 FMU for the eCoSim server. Start the server first.

`ecosim-client-fmu-v3`: Runs an FMI 3.0 FMU for the eCoSim server. Start the server first.

```shell
ecosim-client-fmu-v2 --config-file modules/house/preferences.ini
ecosim-client-fmu-v2 --config-file modules/house/preferences.ini --server-host 192.168.1.20 --server-port 1234
ecosim-client-fmu-v2 --config-file modules/house/preferences.ini --validate-fmu-file-only
ecosim-client-fmu-v3 --config-file modules/controller/preferences.ini
ecosim-client-fmu-v3 --config-file modules/controller/preferences.ini --validate-fmu-file-only
```

**Options**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--config-file FILE` | yes |  | The client's config file, usually preferences.ini in the folder of the model. |
| `--debug` |  | flag | Show debug messages and the full traceback of an error. |
| `--validate-fmu-file-only` |  | flag | Only check the FMU, the .fmc file and the [start_values] of the client config. Starts no client. |

**Server connection**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--server-host HOST` |  |  | The host name or IP address of the server. Overrides ip in the [server] section of the config file. |
| `--server-port PORT` |  |  | The port of the server. Overrides port in the [server] section of the config file. |
| `--image-renderer-port PORT` |  |  | The port of the server's image rendering socket. Without it, the client does not connect to it. |
| `--communication-protocol {dask,tcp_socket}` |  |  | The protocol between the server and the clients, by default tcp_socket. Overrides communication_protocol in the [server] section of the config file. |

## MATLAB, Pyro5 and Python clients

`ecosim-client-matlab`: Runs a model written as MATLAB scripts for the eCoSim server. Needs MATLAB and Python 3.12. Start the server first.

`ecosim-client-pyro5`: Connects a Python model served by a Pyro5 daemon to the eCoSim server. Start the server and the Pyro5 daemon first.

`ecosim-client-python`: Runs a Python model for the eCoSim server without a Pyro5 daemon. The model is set in the [python] section of the config file. Start the server first.

See the [MATLAB client](../guides/matlab-client.md), the [Pyro5 client](../guides/pyro5-client.md) and the [Python client](../guides/python-client.md) guides.

```shell
ecosim-client-matlab --config-file modules/battery/preferences.ini
ecosim-client-pyro5 --config-file modules/grid/preferences.ini
ecosim-client-python --config-file modules/room/preferences.ini
```

**Options**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--config-file FILE` | yes |  | The client's config file, usually preferences.ini in the folder of the model. |
| `--debug` |  | flag | Show debug messages and the full traceback of an error. |

**Server connection**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--server-host HOST` |  |  | The host name or IP address of the server. Overrides ip in the [server] section of the config file. |
| `--server-port PORT` |  |  | The port of the server. Overrides port in the [server] section of the config file. |
| `--image-renderer-port PORT` |  |  | The port of the server's image rendering socket. Without it, the client does not connect to it. |
| `--communication-protocol {dask,tcp_socket}` |  |  | The protocol between the server and the clients, by default tcp_socket. Overrides communication_protocol in the [server] section of the config file. |

## HPC

`ecosim-hpc`: Runs the server and all clients of a simulation on a Dask cluster. Started with mpirun it starts its own Dask cluster. With --interactive it uses a running Dask scheduler.

See the [HPC cluster](../guides/hpc-cluster.md) guide.

```shell
mpirun -np 4 ecosim-hpc --server-config server/preferences.ini --simulation-config server/simulation.json \
    --simulator-dir modules --steps 100 --database-type file
ecosim-hpc --interactive --server-config server/preferences.ini --simulation-config server/simulation.json \
    --simulator-dir modules --steps 100 --database-type file
```

**Options**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--debug` |  | flag | Show debug messages and the full traceback of an error. |

**Config files**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--server-config FILE` | yes |  | The server's config file, usually server/preferences.ini. A relative path starts in the current folder. |
| `--simulation-config FILE` | yes |  | The simulators and their connections, usually server/simulation.json. A relative path starts in the current folder. |
| `--simulator-dir FOLDER` | yes |  | The folder with one folder per simulator, usually modules. |

**Run**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--steps N` |  |  | How many steps the simulation runs. Overrides setup.steps in the simulation config. With --restore-simulation-run it is the number of steps of the whole run. |
| `--step-size MILLISECONDS` |  |  | The simulated time of one step. Overrides setup.delta_t in the simulation config. |
| `--pace NUMBER` |  | `1` | Slows the run down. At 0 the server waits 4 seconds before it sends a simulator its step, at 1 it does not wait. |
| `--restore-simulation-run` |  | flag | Continues an aborted run from its stored results, or starts a new run if there is none. Needs the unchanged config files. |

**Results**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--database-type {postgres,file}` |  |  | Where the results go. Overrides type in the [database] section of the config file. If neither sets it, postgres. |
| `--database-directory FOLDER` |  |  | The folder for the result files of --database-type file. Overrides directory in the [database] section of the config file. If neither sets it, simulation_results. |
| `--database-host HOST` |  |  | The host of the PostgreSQL server. Overrides server in the [database] section of the config file. |
| `--database-port PORT` |  |  | The port of the PostgreSQL server. Overrides port in the [database] section of the config file. |
| `--database-user USER` |  |  | The PostgreSQL user. Overrides username in the [database] section of the config file. |
| `--database-user-password PASSWORD` |  |  | The password of the PostgreSQL user. Other users on a shared machine can see it in the process list. Without it, the password comes from the config file, PGPASSWORD or a password file. |
| `--database-name NAME` |  |  | The PostgreSQL database. Default: sim_control. |

| `--database-drop-existing-schema` |  | flag | Deletes the PostgreSQL schema of an earlier run with all its results. With --restore-simulation-run the schema is kept. |

**Server connection**

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--host HOST` |  |  | The host name or IP address the server listens on. Overrides host in the [server] section of the config file. |

**Image rendering**

| `--image-renderer-port PORT` |  |  | The port of the image rendering socket. Without it, the server opens no such socket. |
| `--image-renderer-interval N` |  |  | Renders images every N steps and sends them over the image rendering socket. Without it, no images are sent. |

**Dask cluster**

| `--network-interface NAME` |  |  | The network interface of the Dask scheduler and the workers with mpirun, for example ib0. |
| `--threads-per-worker N` |  | `2` | The threads of each Dask worker with mpirun. A job with one worker needs at least 2. |

## Exit codes

Every command ends with one of these codes. Without `--debug` an error ends the command with one line, for example:

```text
ecosim-server: error: No such file or directory: /home/user/building/Executable/../server/simulaton.json (run with --debug for the full traceback)
```

With `--debug` the command shows the full traceback.

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | the run finished, or `--validate-fmu-file-only` found no problem |
| 1 | the run failed, the command stopped on an error, or `ecosim check` found a problem |
| 2 | an option is missing or has a wrong value |
| 33 | Ctrl-C (SIGINT) during a run |
| 44 | SIGTERM, for example from `docker stop` or at the end of a SLURM job |
